knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Temperature control decisions belong to the site management with a validated plan.
Restricted refrigeration servicing is not cleaning work.
Temperatures and approvals are the evidence that food was protected.

practicalCriteria: Stops and escalates a simulated request to unplug a unit holding high-risk food.
Cleans reachable surfaces and seals without contaminating stored goods.
Reports a simulated blocked drain and a damaged seal.
passRule: Escalation made before any interruption, surfaces cleaned without contamination, and defects reported. Observed by an assessor.
